query: chi, 3d auth personalized 3d printed items
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'CHI & 3D & personalized & printed')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%CHI%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%CHI%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%3D%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%3D%')
    AND (
      p.title ILIKE '%personalized%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%personalized%'
      OR p.title ILIKE '%custom%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%custom%'
    )
    AND (
      p.title ILIKE '%print%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%print%'
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'CHI & 3D & personalized & printed')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
